decisive_items: positive anti–hepatitis C virus antibody status
lichenoid plaques on the right angle of mouth, bilateral buccal mucosa
Dense bandlike lymphohistiocytic infiltrate in the papillary dermis
response.rationale: The clinical and histopathological features are diagnostic of lichen planus, and the positive anti-HCV serology with elevated liver enzymes indicates an association with hepatitis C, making hepatitis C-associated lichen planus the most specific and likely diagnosis.

rejected.why: Too narrow; only addresses nail involvement and ignores oral and HCV findings.
